notes: The paper's own work is computational: MATLAB image processing and statistics of TEM images taken from other papers, with no experiment. Evidence: "This paper proposes a quantitative methodology to analyze the distribution of diameter from the SEM and TEM images using image processing and statistical analysis. This method is illustrated using few case studies from literature." (main, p. 1, Section 1); "The programming was done in MATLAB." (main, p. 2, Section 3); TEM images are credited "Fig. 2. TEM image [10]." and "Fig. 6. TEM image [12]." (main, pp. 3-4). Uptake values are only quoted, e.g. "Ritschel et al. [8] tested different nanotubes samples and reported a value of 0.63 wt% at 300 K and 4.2 MPa" (main, p. 2, Section 2). I1 failure coded theoretical_only (only computation, no measurement of any kind); if image analysis of published micrographs is not counted as computation, the I1 failure would instead be no_conditions_stated. not_primary not applied: the paper is a method paper with its own analysis results (diameter histograms, Figs. 3, 5, 7, 9), not a review, thesis, patent or abstract. retracted: record is_retracted false and no retraction notice in the PDF. duplicate_data: not applicable, no own H2 values.
